info.name: Slotum
info.description: Requests for the current Slotum backend API. Log in with an existing user first; the Login request saves the JWT as the collection variable accessToken. JWT permissions are captured at login, so log in again after role or permission changes.

variable.description: Email of an existing user; change it for your local database.
Password of that user; replace this placeholder before login.
ID of a notification belonging to the logged-in user.
ID of a stored refresh token.
Hash of a stored refresh token.
Whether to count revoked refresh tokens.
UTC cutoff for refresh-token cleanup; change before sending.

request.description: Requires authority: MARK_OWN_NOTIFICATIONS_READ. Only a notification owned by the current user can be marked as read.

item.name: Mark all my notifications as read

request.description: Requires authority: MARK_OWN_NOTIFICATIONS_READ. Returns the number of notifications marked as read.

item.name: Get slot booking request by id

request.description: Requires authority: MANAGE_ROLES. Role names are limited to the RoleNames enum; seeded roles may already exist.

item.name: Count refresh tokens by revoked status
Revoke all refresh tokens for user
Delete expired or revoked refresh tokens before cutoff
